AUTOMATION.DESCRIPTION: Automation can replace and streamline existing processes that require manual effort, such as adding labels and assigning conversations to the most suitable agent. This allows the team to focus on their strengths while reducing time spent on routine tasks.
AUTOMATION.NO_RESULTS: No automation rules found matching your search

INSTANT.LABEL: Run instantly
INSTANT.DESCRIPTION: Runs the moment an event happens, as long as the conditions match.

WAIT.LABEL: Run after a wait
WAIT.DESCRIPTION: Waits for a set time and runs only if things are still the same. If they change, the rule is skipped.

WAIT.LABEL: Wait condition
WAIT.ERROR: The wait must be between 10 minutes and 30 days

EXPLANATION.CONVERSATION_STATUS: The clock starts when a conversation moves into this status. If it is still there {duration} later, the actions below run. If the status changes before then, nothing happens.
EXPLANATION.CUSTOMER_UNRESPONSIVE: The clock starts when a teammate replies. If the customer hasn't written back {duration} later, the actions below run. If they do reply, nothing happens, and the next teammate reply starts the clock again.
EXPLANATION.AGENT_UNRESPONSIVE: The clock starts when a customer sends a message. If no teammate has replied {duration} later, the actions below run. If someone replies before then, nothing happens.

WAIT.FOOTNOTE: Only new activity starts a clock. Conversations already sitting in this state are picked up the next time something happens on them.

SCHEDULE.LABEL: Schedule
SCHEDULE.ATTRIBUTE_KEY_NONE: No conversation date or datetime attributes found. Create them under Custom attributes.
SCHEDULE.RELATIVE_TO_AFTER: N days after the attribute date
SCHEDULE.RELATIVE_TO_BEFORE: N days before the attribute date
SCHEDULE.RELATIVE_HINT: On the date and N days before fire that calendar day only. N days after still means N or more days later, once.
SCHEDULE.HELP: Scanned about every 5 minutes. Each rule fires once per conversation window.

KINDS.DAYS_SINCE: A date or datetime attribute (before, on, or after)

ACTION.CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_DATETIME_DYNAMIC_HELP: Resolved when the automation or macro runs. Use now, now plus N days, or variables like {{ contact.custom_attribute.foo }}.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE.INBOX_EMPTY: No WhatsApp inboxes in this account
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE.INBOX_HINT: This template is sent only if the conversation is on the WhatsApp inbox selected above. On other inboxes or channels the template is skipped; any other actions in this rule still run.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE.VARIABLES_HINT: Use Liquid variables such as contact.name in template fields.

ACTION.MARK_READ_TYPING_LABEL: Mark as read and show typing
ACTION.DELIVERY_HINT: WhatsApp only for read/typing. Wait 1–25s required for typing. Other channels only wait.
